RemoveVirusScanAdditionalLists.description_en: Removes virus scan blacklists and whitelists entries in batch by entry IDs. The entire removal operation is failed if any of the specified entry IDs do not belong to the current Alibaba Cloud account
RemoveVirusScanAdditionalLists.description_zh: 按名单条目ID批量移除病毒扫描黑白名单条目。存在不属于当前阿里云账号的名单条目ID时整体移除失败

UpdateAntiVirusRealTimeDefenceStrategy.description_en: Configures the real-time anti-virus defense policy for the current Alibaba Cloud account. The first call creates the policy, and subsequent calls update it. The complete updated configuration is returned. When configuring for the first time, Status, MatchMode, HighRiskOperation, MidRiskOperation, LowRiskOperation, and ScanTargets are all required. ScanTargets and Whitelist are full replacements. The collection you pass in replaces the existing configuration. When MatchMode is set to UserGroupNormal, you must pass in the complete UserGroupIds on every call. When Status is not set to Disabled, the system validates the endpoint hardening license count. The call fails if the count exceeds the purchased licenses
UpdateAntiVirusRealTimeDefenceStrategy.description_zh: 配置当前阿里云账号的防病毒实时防御策略，首次调用时创建策略，之后调用更新策略，并返回更新后的完整配置。首次配置时Status、MatchMode、HighRiskOperation、MidRiskOperation、LowRiskOperation与ScanTargets均必须传入。ScanTargets与Whitelist为全量覆盖，传入的集合会替换原有配置；生效范围为UserGroupNormal时每次调用都必须重新传入完整的UserGroupIds。Status不为Disabled时会校验终端加固授权数，超出已购授权数时调用失败

UpdateVirusFileStatus.description_en: Quarantines or trusts a virus file on a specified user terminal device. DevTag, FilePath, and FileMd5 together identify a virus file record. The call fails if the record does not exist. Quarantine is an asynchronous operation. After the server creates a disposal task, the user terminal device pulls and executes it. The same virus file record can only be disposed of once within one minute
UpdateVirusFileStatus.description_zh: 对指定用户终端设备上的病毒文件执行隔离或信任处置。DevTag、FilePath与FileMd5三者共同定位一条病毒文件记录，记录不存在时调用失败。隔离为异步操作，服务端创建处置任务后由用户终端设备拉取执行。同一条病毒文件记录1分钟内只允许处置一次

UpdateVirusScanGlobalConfig.description_en: Modifies the anti-virus global configuration for the current Alibaba Cloud account. The four configuration items are treated as a whole and are entirely overwritten with each call. Therefore, pass in the complete configuration with each call: set VirusFileUpload to false, UploadFileSuffixBlacklist to empty, and UploadFileMaxSize and UploadFileMaxSpeed to 0 (no limit). After VirusFileUpload is changed, the virus file upload module switch is synchronously updated, which affects whether cloud-based STS tokens are issued to user terminal devices
UpdateVirusScanGlobalConfig.description_zh: 修改当前阿里云账号的防病毒全局配置。四项配置为一个整体，每次调用都会整体覆盖，因此每次调用都需要传入完整配置：VirusFileUpload按false、UploadFileSuffixBlacklist按空、UploadFileMaxSize与UploadFileMaxSpeed按0（即不限制）写入。VirusFileUpload变更后会同步更新病毒文件上传模块开关，影响是否向用户终端设备签发云查STS Token

UpdateVirusScanScheduledStrategy.description_en: Modifies the configuration of a specified scheduled virus scan policy. The Whitelist parameter performs a full overwrite, meaning the provided list replaces the existing exception user list of the policy
UpdateVirusScanScheduledStrategy.description_zh: 修改指定病毒定时扫描策略的配置。其中Whitelist为全量覆盖，传入的名单会替换该策略原有的例外用户名单

UpdateVulScanGlobalConfig.description_en: Modifies the global vulnerability scanning configuration for the current Alibaba Cloud account and returns the complete updated configuration
UpdateVulScanGlobalConfig.description_zh: 修改当前阿里云账号的漏洞扫描全局配置，并返回修改后的完整配置

UpdateVulScanScheduledStrategy.description_en: Modifies the configuration of a specified vulnerability scheduled scan policy and returns the complete updated configuration
